notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome124) succeeded for every page; robots.txt (https://www.juttu.be/robots.txt) has no full-site Disallow and no Claude-specific block, only disallows /api, /account, /checkout etc - homepage and all category pages fetched cleanly (200), no escalation to Playwright/Chrome needed. TREE: Juttu.be is primarily a fashion/apparel retailer (Dames/Heren clothing) with a small 'Home' mega-menu section (Home & deco / Boeken / Food / Verzorging). Built the tree from the union of the mega-menu JSON (embedded in the homepage as data-hypernova-key=AEMScenes_MobileNavigation) and the XML sitemap (https://www.juttu.be/sitemap/category-1.xml, 583 URLs), then verified every leaf by fetching the page and reading the embedded AEMScenes_ProductLister JSON blob (props.title / props.itemCount / props.filters), confirming h1==requested node on each. Mega-menu listed a 'Kussens' (cushions) link pointing to a legacy /nl/categories/9319/10031/10034.html URL that 404s and does not appear in the sitemap or in the live 'Type product' facet list on the parent wonen.html page (facet values: Keukenservies, Keukengerei, Accessoires, Kaarsen, Speelgoed binnen, Vazen en bloempotten, Geurstokjes, Tuinaccessoires, Opbergen, Gadgets, Planten, Verlichting, Fotolijsten en posters, Speelgoed buiten, Decoratie, Meubilair - no cushions facet) - treated as a dead/retired category, not recorded (no valid qty/URL available, would be fabrication). Found a dedicated Textiel (Textiles) node (home-deco/textiel.html) not present in the visible mega-menu but present in the sitemap, with 3 real children (Plaids/Throws, Handdoeken/Towels, Strandlaken/Beach Towels); did not record the Textiel parent URL itself since valid subcategories exist (rule 25). Also found Keukentextiel (Kitchen Textiles) nested under Keuken (Kitchen, out of scope) - the 2 products are both tea towels, genuinely textile, so recorded as its own Textile leaf under a Kitchen grouping row. QTY: every qty is props.itemCount read from the AEMScenes_ProductLister JSON embedded in each category page's HTML (same field the site's own filter/pagination UI is built from); cross-checked against the 'Type product' filter facet counts on the parent pages, which summed to the same totals (e.g. Textiel parent itemCount=7 = Strandlaken 5 + Handdoeken 2, Plaids 0 not shown as a facet value because it has 0 items). Plaids/Throws recorded with qty=0 because the page explicitly returns itemCount=0 (a genuine, currently-empty but live category, not an estimate). EXCLUDED: Opbergen (Storage, wonen/opbergen.html) qty=10 - included in Storage since the website itself names and structures this as its 'Opbergen' (storage) category, but flagged MEDIUM confidence because several of the 10 listed products (trinket dishes, a jewellery box) lean decorative rather than pure storage per storage.md 23-24; kept in per storage.md's core rule that the website's own category hierarchy is the strongest evidence. Excluded Kaarsen (candles), Vazen en bloempotten (vases/pots), Fotolijsten en posters (photo frames/posters), Decoratie (decor), Speelgoed (toys), Gadgets, Geurstokjes (home fragrance), Meubilair (furniture), Verlichting (lighting), Tuinaccessoires (garden accessories), Keukenservies/Keukengerei (kitchenware/tableware) - all Kitchen & Dining/Decorative Home Accessories/Furniture/Lighting/neither per the boundary sections of both rule files. Excluded all Dames/Heren (women's/men's clothing, apparel, bags, shoes, jewellery) as fashion, all Boeken (books)/Food/Verzorging (personal care) as neither category, and all merken/lookbook/promoties/legal/account/checkout/store-locator pages as non-category noise. No View-All, Collection, search-result, or product-detail URLs used. No duplicate URLs across the two arrays.
